findings.message: audit_scene_plan is clean (0 problems, 0 advisories): 13 visual events across 8 beats, subject_fraction 1.0, 26 queries.

The opening hook event ev-1 declares carries_moment but no moment_copy on purpose: Film Type 2.16 charges the simultaneous 3-5s opening hook with rendered-pixel fit and rendered review, not the sequential PersianMoment reading model that moment_copy_feasibility_problems applies. Stating copy there would charge an exempt hook with the wrong model.
The other 7 moment-carrying events DO state moment_copy and were charged at plan time: floors sum to 25.9s against the 34.4s (55%) coverage ceiling, so the edit stage has headroom.

negative_space is upper_band/centre_band only: left_column/right_column are 0.25 of the frame wide inside the vertical safe area, below the 0.56 curated column fraction, and lower_band has zero usable height (reserved for captions).
